abstract: This study analyzes the effects of a nationwide school reform in Israel on student achievement and the school learning environment. The New Horizon reform, initiated by the Ministry of Education, was gradually implemented in elementary schools beginning in 2008. It increased the time teachers spend in school, introduced small-group learning, raised teachers’ and principals’ salaries, and established higher requirements and incentives for professional development. Using a staggered difference-in-differences approach, we evaluate the reform’s effects on student achievement and the school learning environment. We find that in the four years following implementation, math and English test scores improved alongside various aspects of the learning environment. We offer suggestive evidence that the math gains are driven by small-group learning targeting lower-achieving students, while English gains are consistent with improved net working conditions for English teachers.
title: A new horizon? The effect of a national education reform on student achievement and the academic environment

abstract: Reputation and social punishment are key mechanisms for norm enforcement, yet existing research often conflates or treats them in isolation. We distinguish reputational punishment as the automatic loss of trust-based interactions following defection, from social punishment, the voluntary avoidance in interactions maintained independently from reputation. Integrating both in a model of informal enforcement, we show that social punishment complements reputation when it is too weak to support cooperation alone, but as reputation strength increases, it substitutes for social punishment, resulting in an inverted-U-shaped relationship between punishment and reputational strength. The mechanism provides a novel motivation for third-party punishment driven by how reputation amplifies punishment threats across an agent’s network. Payoffs depend on the distribution of interaction stakes, determining how many new transactions punishment facilitates. We consider social structure by defining ingroups by their capacity to independently enforce trust, implying incentives to renegotiate from universal to localised norms. However, when community enforcement is insufficient, ingroup members may impose additional punishment on defectors, mimicking collective reputation. Extending the model to regulate multiple norms within a single domain has distinct implications for punishment intensity, and the model’s equilibria provide a mechanism rationalising the inconsistent cross-cultural relationship between cooperation and enforcement intensity. The framework contributes to the literature on informal enforcement, social capital, and social norms by explaining how the nature and intensity of interactions and the costs of complying with a community’s norms influence patterns of social enforcement and norm compliance across different social structures.
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
title: Reputation, punishment and the enforcement of social norms

abstract: Thu Duc, a rapidly urbanizing area of Ho Chi Minh City, is well located and heavily invested in policy ambition, yet its output and density remain far below what its position in the metropolitan economy would support. Much of it is also flood exposed. This paper asks how much of that shortfall flood risk explains, and what coordinated investment could recover. A Spatial Computable General Equilibrium model of the Greater Ho Chi Minh City Metropolitan Area, covering 116 cells across Ho Chi Minh City and neighboring provinces, evaluates interventions to 2040. The model endogenizes firm location, household residence and commuting, land use intensity, and agglomeration externalities, recovering cell-level productivity and amenity parameters by structural calibration against observed employment and residential distributions. Its methodological contribution is to integrate spatially explicit flood exposure as a determinant of those fundamentals, so flood risk is evaluated within the same general equilibrium framework as transport and land use, and local gains can be separated into net new metropolitan output and activity reallocated from elsewhere. Thu Duc's calibrated productivity is roughly one-third of the metropolitan average, implying that frontier output is more than five times the business-as-usual level. Flood mitigation raises sectoral total factor productivity by 12 to 21 percent and residential amenity by 10 to 13 percent, and it broadens the sectoral employment base more than the other interventions examined. A cumulative package of innovation zones, flood mitigation, and transport reaches about 31 percent of that frontier, raising output roughly two-thirds above business as usual, of which some 56 percent is net new output for the metropolis.

abstract: We consider testing zero pricing errors in high-dimensional linear factor pricing models. Existing methods are mainly based on either an L 2 statistic, which is effective under dense alternatives, or an L ∞ statistic, which is powerful under very sparse alternatives. To bridge these two regimes, we develop a class of Lq -based tests for finite q, including the practically useful L 4 and L 6 cases. We show that larger q leads to greater sensitivity to sparse alternatives. We further establish the asymptotic independence between the L ∞ statistic and the Lq statistic for any finite q, which motivates a Cauchy combination test that adapts to a broad range of sparsity levels. Simulation studies and a real-data analysis show that the proposed methods are more robust to the unknown sparsity of the alternative and can outperform existing procedures in finite samples.
title: High dimensional alpha test for linear factor pricing model with Lq-norm

abstract: Does the cashless limit of the monetary equilibrium converge to the non-monetary equilibrium? We revisit the question in the context of Menzio and Spinella (2025), a model in which the financial market where households lend savings and firms borrow capital is subject to frictions. The fraction of households that do not meet any firms determines money demand. The fractions of households that meet one or multiple firms determine the extent of competition, and the sensitivity of real rates to inflation. The cashless limit of the monetary equilibrium converges to the non-monetary equilibrium depending on whether the financial market becomes perfectly competitive, which, in turn, depends on the exact specification of frictions.
title: More on onetary Economics

abstract: We study fertility responses to employment shocks using unique Hungarian administrative data linking firm-level mass layoff and closure events to individual-level birth and abortion records. We show that the main fertility response occurs in anticipation and differs by shock type. The number of conceptions leading to births increases in the year preceding a mass layoff (when maternal employment protection is available), but not before a firm closure (without employment protection). We interpret this result as evidence of anticipatory fertility behavior: women tend to schedule childbirth when job loss can be avoided.
abstract_zh: 我们利用匈牙利独特的行政数据，将企业层面的大规模裁员和关闭事件与个人层面的生育及堕胎记录相链接，研究就业冲击对生育率的影响。结果显示，主要的生育反应发生在预期阶段，且因冲击类型而异。在大规模裁员前一年（当母亲享有就业保护时），导致生育的受孕数量有所增加，但在企业关闭前（无就业保护时）则无此现象。我们将此结果解释为预期性生育行为的证据：女性倾向于在能够避免失业时安排生育。
title: Anticipatory Fertility
title_zh: 预期性生育

abstract: We implement a randomized information intervention to enhance beliefs about the productivity of effort on a cohort of undergraduate students at a UK university. The intervention increases first-year exam grades and GPA, with an intention-to-treat effect of 0.10 of a standard deviation. The effects are larger for men, reducing the gender gap in academic achievement by a third. The data allow us to examine the mechanisms linking the intervention to outcomes, through changes in beliefs and academic inputs, as well as its longer-term effects. We replicate the main results at another UK university, highlighting the external validity of our findings.
abstract_zh: 我们实施了一项随机信息干预，旨在增强英国某大学本科生对努力生产力的信念。该干预提升了大一考试成绩和平均绩点，意向处理效应为0.10个标准差。对男性的影响更大，将学业成就中的性别差距缩小了三分之一。数据使我们能够考察干预通过信念和学术投入变化影响结果的机制，以及其长期效应。我们在另一所英国大学复制了主要结果，凸显了我们发现的外部有效性。
title: Expectations about the Productivity of Effort and Academic Outcomes
title_zh: 关于努力生产力的预期与学业成果

abstract: This paper examines how U.S. firms manage environmental and social performance in response to U.S. policy shifts surrounding the Paris Agreement. Following the U.S. entry into the Agreement in 2016, firms increased their environmental scores while their social scores declined, without corresponding near-term reductions in greenhouse gas emissions. The increase in environmental score partially reversed within a year, whereas the decline in social score persisted. This short-run ESG trade-off was stronger among financially constrained firms and was attenuated when investor scrutiny of social issues intensified. By contrast, following the U.S. re-entry in 2021, firms improved both their environmental and social scores and achieved meaningful reductions in emission intensity. Our evidence reveals an early “clash” between ESG pillars that gradually transitioned toward more integrated sustainability strategies over time. We also show that greater shareholder scrutiny and pressure may have contributed to the post-2020 shift.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国企业如何应对围绕《巴黎协定》的美国政策变动来管理其环境与社会绩效。2016年美国加入该协定后，企业提升了环境评分，而社会评分却有所下降，且短期内并未伴随温室气体排放的相应减少。环境评分的提升在一年内部分逆转，而社会评分的下降则持续存在。这种短期内的ESG权衡在财务受限企业中表现更为显著，而当投资者对社会议题的关注增强时，该权衡效应则有所减弱。相比之下，2021年美国重新加入协定后，企业同时改善了环境与社会评分，并在排放强度上实现了实质性降低。我们的证据揭示了ESG支柱间早期的“冲突”，这种冲突随时间推移逐渐转向更为整合的可持续发展战略。同时，我们也表明，股东更严格的审视与压力可能促进了2020年后的这一转变。
title: Clash between environmental and social pillars: Evidence from U.S. policy shifts on the Paris agreement
title_zh: 环境与社会支柱之间的冲突：来自美国对巴黎协定政策转变的证据

abstract: Transhumant pastoralism is a major livelihood system in West Africa, supporting food security and household incomes while remaining highly vulnerable to climatic variability and land-use change. This study investigates pastoralists’ perceptions of climate variability and land-use change, their impacts on pastoral resources and practices, and the adaptation strategies adopted in the Ferlo region of Senegal. Climate trends for the period 1981–2024 were assessed using ETCCDI climate indices and Sen’s slope, while pastoral perceptions, constraints, and adaptation strategies were analysed from a survey of 306 transhumant, sedentary, and agropastoral herders across six municipalities using descriptive statistics and correspondence analysis. Results showed significant warming of nighttime temperatures across the three study sites, with increasing warm nights and declining cool nights, while rainfall trends varied spatially. Pastoralists reported contrasting constraints across production systems. Transhumant herders primarily associated environmental change with mobility constraints, including blocked transhumance corridors, water scarcity, conflicts, and cross-border restrictions, whereas sedentary and agropastoral herders more frequently reported pasture degradation, declining forage quality, and feed shortages. Land-use change and land fragmentation further restricted access to grazing resources and water points and contributed to farmer-herder conflicts. Adaptation strategies differed across production systems: transhumant herders relied strongly on transhumance (100%), herd diversification (69%), and herd reduction (66.7%), whereas sedentary and agropastoral herders relied extensively on feed supplementation and crop-residue storage. Traditional ethnoveterinary practices also supported livestock health management. These findings highlight the urgent need for policies that secure pastoral mobility, protect transhumance corridors, and strengthen inclusive land and resource governance. Supporting community-based management and reinforcing agropastoral synergies are critical to enhancing the resilience of pastoral systems under growing climatic and socio-institutional pressures.
abstract_zh: 跨humance游牧是西非一种主要的生计系统，支撑着粮食安全和家庭收入，同时极易受到气候变异和土地利用变化的影响。本研究调查了塞内加尔费尔洛地区牧民对气候变异和土地利用变化的感知、其对牧业资源和实践的影响，以及所采取的适应策略。利用ETCCDI气候指数和Sen斜率评估了1981—2024年期间的气候趋势，同时通过对六个市镇306名跨humance游牧、定居和农牧混合牧民的调查，采用描述性统计和对应分析，分析了牧民的感知、制约因素和适应策略。结果显示，三个研究地点的夜间温度显著升高，暖夜增加而冷夜减少，而降雨趋势在空间上存在差异。牧民报告了不同生产系统之间的对比性制约因素。跨humance游牧牧民主要将环境变化与流动性制约联系起来，包括跨humance走廊受阻、水资源短缺、冲突和跨境限制，而定居和农牧混合牧民则更频繁地报告牧场退化、饲草质量下降和饲料短缺。土地利用变化和土地碎片化进一步限制了对放牧资源和水源的获取，并加剧了农牧民之间的冲突。适应策略因生产系统而异：跨humance游牧牧民高度依赖跨humance（100%）、畜群多样化（69%）和畜群缩减（66.7%），而定居和农牧混合牧民则广泛依赖饲料补充和作物残留物储存。传统民族兽医学实践也支持了牲畜健康管理。这些发现凸显了迫切需要制定保障牧业流动性、保护跨humance走廊并加强包容性土地和资源治理的政策。支持社区为基础的管理并加强农牧协同，对于在日益增长的气候和社会制度压力下增强牧业系统的韧性至关重要。
title: Climate and land-use change impacts on pastoral systems in the Ferlo, Senegal: Perceptions and adaptation strategies
title_zh: 塞内加尔费尔洛地区气候与土地利用变化对牧区系统的影响：认知与适应策略

abstract: Land use optimization plays pivotal roles in bridging regional sustainable development with national strategic priorities, yet persistent methodological disconnects between diagnostic evaluation and prescriptive optimization hinder practical implementation. Addressing this critical gap, this research develops an integrated “Evaluation-Diagnosis-Simulation-Optimization” (EDSO) framework through synergistic coupling of multi-dimensional functional indices, PLUS modeling, and random forest. The framework utilizes multi-source geospatial data with Lingbao City, Henan Province, China, as the case study area. The results indicate that the transition marked by 1.40% farmland loss due to forest regeneration and urban-rural construction expansion, while non-agricultural output value surged by 23.09% alongside improved infrastructure accessibility (2012–2020). Rural depopulation paralleled the degradation of commercial and public services, exposing vulnerabilities in rural governance. The simulation demonstrates the comprehensive optimized scenario's superiority in landscape efficiency, with 280 million CNY higher ecological value than alternatives. The optimized schedule identified 200.22 km² of land returned to forest and 4.32 km² of fragmented rural low-efficiency built-up land. The schedule identified forest carbon sink peaking at 35-year tree growth cycles, critical insights informing 30m-resolution rotation scheme. The EDSO framework's ability to integrate diagnostic analytics with spatially adaptive interventions offers a transformative toolkit for territorial planning, effectively bridging the science-policy gap.
abstract_zh: 土地利用优化在连接区域可持续发展与国家战略优先事项中发挥着关键作用，然而诊断评估与规范优化之间长期存在的方法论脱节阻碍了实际应用。针对这一关键缺口，本研究通过多维功能指标、PLUS模型与随机森林的协同耦合，构建了集成的“评估-诊断-模拟-优化”（EDSO）框架。该框架利用多源地理空间数据，以中国河南省灵宝市为案例研究区域。结果表明，2012—2020年间，以1.40%耕地因森林恢复和城乡建设用地扩张而流失为特征的转型过程中，非农产值增长了23.09%，基础设施可达性同步改善。农村人口流失与商业和公共服务退化并行，暴露了乡村治理中的脆弱性。模拟结果表明，综合优化情景在景观效率方面具有优越性，其生态价值比替代情景高出2.8亿元。优化方案识别出200.22 km²土地需退耕还林，以及4.32 km²碎片化的农村低效建设用地。该方案识别出森林碳汇在35年树木生长周期达到峰值，为30米分辨率的轮作方案提供了关键见解。EDSO框架将诊断分析与空间适应性干预相结合的能力，为国土空间规划提供了一套变革性工具，有效弥合了科学与政策之间的鸿沟。

abstract: This study examines the impact of water availability on the urban land market by focusing on a large-scale inter-basin water transfer project in China. Employing a difference-in-differences framework and a unique parcel-level dataset, we find that the project increased average land prices in water-receiving areas by 8.47% while also stimulating urban land market activity, and ultimately promote urban economic growth and expansion. These effects are primarily driven by two channels: population growth and mobility, and accelerated industrial expansion—all induced by the large-scale water transfer. Additional analyses further reveal that the project’s influence on land price is almost entirely concentrated in residential and commercial land parcels, with negligible effects observed for industrial land. And the positive impacts are more pronounced along the project’s middle route and in arid counties. Notably, we find no empirical evidence of adverse effects on land markets in water-supplying areas. A back-of-the-envelope calculation suggests that the appreciation in land values could recoup over one-third of the project’s total investment, underscoring its substantial economic benefits.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过聚焦中国一项大规模跨流域调水工程，探讨了水资源可得性对城市土地市场的影响。采用双重差分框架及独特的地块层面数据集，我们发现该工程使受水区平均地价上升了8.47%，同时促进了城市土地市场活跃度，并最终推动了城市经济增长与扩张。这些效应主要通过两个渠道实现：人口增长与流动性增强，以及由大规模调水引发的产业加速扩张。进一步分析揭示，该工程对地价的影响几乎完全集中于住宅和商业用地地块，对工业用地的影响微乎其微。此外，正面效应在工程中线沿线及干旱县域更为显著。值得注意的是，我们未发现任何实证证据表明该工程对供水区土地市场产生不利影响。粗略估算显示，土地价值的增值可回收工程总投资的逾三分之一，凸显了其可观的经济效益。

abstract: Agricultural commercialization represents a critical pathway for smallholders to integrate into modern markets. Yet fragmented landholdings, an aging rural workforce, and high transaction costs continue to constrain smallholders’ market participation. Drawing on data from the China Land Economic Survey (CLES) from 2020 to 2022, this study examines the association between agricultural production outsourcing and smallholder commercialization, measured by the crop commercialization index. The analysis employs an instrumental variable strategy that exploits peer-driven variation in village-level outsourcing adoption, complemented by robustness checks under alternative identifying assumptions. The results show that outsourcing adoption is positively associated with the degree of smallholder commercialization. Mechanism analysis suggests three potential pathways associated with this relationship: higher mechanization intensity, larger operational scale, and greater crop diversification. Heterogeneity analyses indicate stronger associations for harvesting and labor-saving services and among younger farmers, whereas land fragmentation attenuates the relationship. These findings extend research on agricultural outsourcing from production-side outcomes to market integration and highlight the potential role of agricultural service systems in smallholder commercialization.
abstract_zh: 农业商业化是小农户融入现代市场的重要途径。然而，土地细碎化、农村劳动力老龄化以及高昂的交易成本持续制约着小农户的市场参与。本研究利用2020至2022年中国土地经济调查（CLES）数据，考察农业生产经营外包与小农户商业化程度（以作物商业化指数衡量）之间的关联。分析采用工具变量策略，利用村级外包采纳中的同伴驱动变异，并在替代识别假设下进行稳健性检验。结果表明，外包采纳与小农户商业化程度呈正相关。机制分析提示，这一关联可能通过三条潜在路径实现：机械化强度提高、经营规模扩大以及作物多样化程度提升。异质性分析显示，收割类及节省劳动力类服务的作用更为显著，且对年轻农户的影响更强，而土地细碎化则会削弱这一关联。这些发现将农业外包研究从生产侧结果拓展至市场整合层面，并凸显了农业服务体系在小农户商业化中的潜在作用。

abstract: We develop the Sample Splitting Alpha (SSA) test, a formal out-of-sample (OOS) test for evaluating whether an asset pricing factor model satisfies the zero-alpha restriction in high-dimensional settings. The test uses sample splitting to separate portfolio weight estimation from model evaluation and ridge regularization to stabilize the portfolio problem when the number of test assets is large. We show that each single SSA statistic is asymptotically Gaussian under mild regularity conditions. For the aggregated SSA statistic used in implementation, we characterize the dependence across split statistics and compute p-values by resampling. Economically, the statistic relates to the OOS incremental spanning value of the chosen test assets relative to a candidate factor model, measured by the OOS squared information ratio. The simulation results accord with the asymptotic analysis. In empirical applications, SSA rejects some statistically constructed factor models more often than the in-sample benchmarks, despite those models’ strong in-sample fit.
abstract_zh: 我们开发了样本分割阿尔法（SSA）检验，这是一种正式的样本外（OOS）检验，用于评估资产定价因子模型在高维环境下是否满足零阿尔法约束。该检验利用样本分割将投资组合权重估计与模型评估分离，并采用岭正则化来稳定测试资产数量较大时的投资组合问题。我们证明，在温和的正则条件下，每个单独的SSA统计量渐近服从高斯分布。对于实施中使用的聚合SSA统计量，我们刻画了分割统计量之间的依赖性，并通过重抽样计算p值。从经济学角度看，该统计量与所选测试资产相对于候选因子模型的OOS增量跨越价值相关，该价值通过OOS平方信息比率衡量。模拟结果与渐近分析一致。在实证应用中，尽管某些统计构建的因子模型具有强大的样本内拟合，SSA比样本内基准更频繁地拒绝这些模型。
title: Testing asset pricing factor models: An out-of-sample perspective
title_zh: 检验资产定价因子模型：基于样本外的视角

abstract: This paper examines the political consequences of debt deflation in interwar Germany. Debt deflation arises when falling prices increase the real burden of pre-existing nominal liabilities. We study this mechanism in the agricultural sector, where farmers had accumulated substantial nominal debt before 1929. In the face of collapsing agricultural prices and falling incomes, the high nominal interest burden made this debt unsustainable. To isolate the political effect of this shock, we exploit pre-deflation differences in agricultural debt and product mix across counties to construct a measure of debt deflation intensity. Our main finding is that rural debt deflation substantially increased support for the Nazi party, reflecting substitution away from agrarian and conservative parties. A one-standard-deviation increase in exposure explains a fifth of one standard deviation in the Nazi party vote share rise between 1928 and 1932. A counterfactual exercise suggests that without debt deflation, the Nazi party’s national vote share would have been insufficient to prevent less extreme parties from forming a majority coalition against it, rendering rural debt deflation a plausibly necessary condition for Hitler’s rise to power.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了两次世界大战之间德国债务通缩的政治后果。债务通缩是指价格下跌增加了既有名义负债的实际负担。我们研究了农业部门中的这一机制，该部门农民在1929年前积累了大量的名义债务。面对农产品价格崩溃和收入下降，高名义利息负担使这些债务变得不可持续。为隔离这一冲击的政治效应，我们利用各县在通缩前农业债务和产品结构的差异，构建了一个债务通缩强度的度量指标。我们的主要发现是，农村债务通缩显著增加了对纳粹党的支持，反映出选民从农业党和保守党转向纳粹党。暴露程度每增加一个标准差，可解释1928年至1932年间纳粹党得票率上升中五分之一的变动。一项反事实模拟表明，若无债务通缩，纳粹党的全国得票率将不足以阻止较温和政党形成反对它的多数联盟，从而使农村债务通缩成为希特勒上台的一个可能必要条件。
title: Debt deflation and the rise of the Nazi party
title_zh: 债务通缩与纳粹党的崛起

abstract: Recent studies of Ivy-Plus institutions suggest that standardized test scores (SAT/ACT) are better predictors of college success than high school grade point average (HSGPA). In response, many elite colleges have re-instituted the requirement that test scores be submitted for admission. We ask whether re-establishing the SAT requirement for admission at a large urban public university system (hereafter the System) would improve the predictability of academic outcomes using administrative data for the 2010–2019 first-year cohorts. We also assess the use of a state-wide exam of English Language Arts (ELA) taken by students in their junior year of high school as a substitute for the SAT. Unobserved variables that determine who is admitted and where applicants matriculate can confound estimates of the effects of SAT and HSGPA on academic outcomes. While selection bias remains unavoidable, we estimate effects for subsamples of students whose choice of colleges outside the System, and campuses within the System, are likely limited. We also apply recent sensitivity tests that assess how strong a confounder would have to be to eliminate the effect of HSGPA or SAT on the outcomes. We find that a one-standard-deviation increase in HSGPA is at least six times more predictive of six-year graduation than a comparable increase in SAT or the ELA. The estimated effect of HSGPA is robust to the inclusion of student characteristics, whereas the SAT and ELA are not. The adoption of a test-optional policy should not undermine the System’s ability to assess applicants’ potential for success in college.
abstract_zh: 近期针对常春藤联盟高校的研究表明，标准化考试成绩（SAT/ACT）比高中平均绩点（HSGPA）更能预测大学成功。对此，许多精英大学已重新要求提交考试成绩作为录取条件。我们探讨的是，在一个大型城市公立大学系统（以下简称“该系统”）中，重新设立SAT入学要求是否能提高学术成果的可预测性，利用2010至2019年新生队列的行政数据进行分析。同时，我们也评估了将高中三年级学生参加的州级英语语言艺术（ELA）考试作为SAT替代品的可行性。决定谁被录取以及申请者选择就读哪所大学的未观测变量，可能会混淆SAT和HSGPA对学术成果影响的估计。尽管选择偏差难以完全避免，我们针对那些选择该系统外大学及系统内校区可能性有限的子样本学生进行了效应估计。我们还应用了最新的敏感性测试，以评估一个混淆变量需有多强才能消除HSGPA或SAT对成果的影响。研究发现，HSGPA每增加一个标准差，对六年毕业率的预测能力至少是SAT或ELA同等增幅的六倍。HSGPA的估计效应在加入学生特征后依然稳健，而SAT和ELA则不然。采用考试可选政策不应削弱该系统评估申请者大学成功潜力的能力。
title: Standardized test scores and academic performance at a public university system
title_zh: 公立大学系统中标准化考试成绩与学业表现的关系

abstract: The Low Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC) is the largest U.S. federal affordable housing program, yet its impacts on children are largely unknown. Using geocoded Florida Natality data and LIHTC addresses (1980–2024), we examine how childhood LIHTC exposure affects early-adulthood health among women born to mothers with a high school degree or less, and their infants. Matching tracts with and without LIHTC, we find a one standard deviation increase in exposure improves maternal health, infant health, and maternal SES indices by 0.015, 0.010, and 0.007 standard deviations. Effects are largest for Black women, who most often live in LIHTC units.
title: Affordable Housing During Childhood Improves Long-Term Outcomes of Women and Their Children
title_zh: 童年期可负担住房改善女性及其子女的长期结果

abstract: We study an intervention that reduced cesarean deliveries among low-risk first-time mothers, using California birth records linked to earnings data. Exposed mothers were 8% less likely to have a c-section, with no adverse health effects. We find suggestive evidence that they were more likely to return to their pre-birth employer and had higher within-firm earnings rankings in the quarter postbirth. These labor market gains fade over time. However, mothers who had a second child were less likely to have a c-section or preterm delivery, suggesting our estimated effects from avoiding a first c-section may be lower bounds on total gains.
title: The Labor Market and Health Impacts of Reducing Cesarean Section Deliveries
title_zh: 降低剖宫产分娩率对劳动力市场与健康的影响

abstract: This paper examines the differential impact of job displacement on migrants and natives. Using administrative data for Germany from 1997–2016, we identify mass layoffs and estimate the trajectory of earnings and employment of observationally similar migrants and natives displaced from the same establishment. Despite similar pre-layoff careers, migrants’ earnings losses are about 23% larger in the first five years after displacement. This gap arises from both lower re-employment probabilities and post-layoff wages and is not driven by selective return migration. Key mechanisms include sorting into lower-quality firms and relying on lower-quality coworker networks during job search.
title: The Labor Market Costs of Job Displacement by Migrant Status
title_zh: 按移民身份划分的岗位置换劳动力市场成本

abstract: AI promises to accelerate and broaden access to automated investment advice. But can it capture the investment preferences and rationales of historically underrepresented investors? We ask 1272 human survey respondents and 1350 AI-generated agents to rate stocks, bonds, and cash. First, default AI-generated responses overrepresent young, high-income individuals. However, algorithmic bias is reduced with demographically-seeded prompts. Second, AI-generated free-form responses correctly reflect human rationales: risk and return, financial knowledge, and past experiences. Third, AI can help identify where a lack of financial knowledge poses issues in human responses, as shown in textual analyses of transitivity violations.
title: AI and perception biases in investments: An experimental study
title_zh: 人工智能与投资中的认知偏差：一项实验研究

abstract: This paper examines whether industrial robot adoption affects marriage formation in China. Using micro-level data from the China Family Panel Studies for 2010–2020 matched with a city-level measure of robot exposure, we find that greater robot exposure significantly reduces the probability of marriage formation. Further analysis shows that industrial robots asymmetrically reshape the labour-market positions of men and women, thereby altering relative economic position and marriage incentives. The effect operates through three channels: stronger incentives for human-capital investment, gender-differentiated labour-market adjustment, and occupational reallocation. The negative effect is more pronounced among high-income individuals, younger cohorts, migrants, and residents of cities with weaker manufacturing bases, indicating that the marriage consequences of automation extend beyond direct low-skilled manufacturing displacement. More flexible employment arrangements, stronger social protection, and more egalitarian gender norms mitigate the adverse effect. Overall, the findings show that industrial robots affect marriage formation through broader labour-market restructuring.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了工业机器人应用是否影响中国的婚姻形成。利用2010—2020年中国家庭追踪调查的微观数据，并结合城市层面的机器人暴露度指标，我们发现机器人暴露度越高，婚姻形成的概率显著降低。进一步分析表明，工业机器人不对称地重塑了男性和女性在劳动力市场中的地位，从而改变了相对经济地位和婚姻激励。其影响通过三个渠道发挥作用：人力资本投资激励增强、性别差异化的劳动力市场调整以及职业再配置。负面效应在高收入群体、年轻队列、流动人口以及制造业基础较弱城市的居民中更为显著，这表明自动化的婚姻后果不仅限于直接的低技能制造业岗位替代。更灵活的就业安排、更强的社会保障以及更平等的性别规范能够缓解这一不利影响。总体而言，研究结果表明，工业机器人通过更广泛的劳动力市场重构影响婚姻形成。

abstract: This study examines the within-firm association between foreign blockholder ownership and corporate tax avoidance using 36,717 firm-year observations for Chinese A-share firms from 2007 to 2024. Greater foreign blockholder ownership is associated with lower statutory–effective tax-rate gaps and discretionary book–tax differences. A 10-percentage-point increase in ownership is associated with reductions equivalent to approximately 19.7% of the sample mean for the statutory–effective tax-rate gap and 20.5% for discretionary book–tax differences. The estimates remain negative and statistically significant under alternative ownership measures, additional controls, richer fixed effects, long-run cash effective tax rates, permutation tests, and matched-firm panel specifications. MSCI-based instrumental-variable estimates provide complementary evidence in the same direction. We then examine media, analyst, and regulatory responses to tax avoidance. Negative media coverage and recorded tax-related violations become more responsive to tax avoidance as foreign blockholder ownership rises, whereas analyst following moves in the opposite direction. The negative ownership association is stronger in regions with higher marketization and among firms receiving greater public attention, but weaker in state-owned enterprises. These findings identify foreign blockholding as a distinct governance arrangement whose relationship with corporate tax avoidance depends on whether domestic institutions and public information support outside shareholder oversight. KEYWORDS: Foreign blockholders corporate tax avoidance corporate governance cross-border ownership external monitoring JEL CLASSIFICATION: F21 G34 H26
abstract_zh: 本研究利用2007年至2024年间中国A股上市公司36，717个公司-年度观测值，考察了外资大股东持股与公司避税行为之间的企业内关联。外资大股东持股比例越高，法定税率与实际税率之差及 discretionary book–tax differences（可自由支配的账面-税务差异）越小。持股比例每增加10个百分点，法定税率与实际税率之差约降低样本均值的19.7%，可自由支配的账面-税务差异约降低20.5%。在采用替代持股度量、增加控制变量、引入更丰富的固定效应、使用长期现金有效税率、进行置换检验及匹配样本面板设定后，估计结果仍为负且统计显著。基于MSCI的工具变量估计提供了方向一致的补充证据。随后，本文考察了媒体、分析师及监管机构对避税行为的反应。随着外资大股东持股比例上升，负面媒体报道及记录的税务相关违规行为对避税行为的反应更为敏感，而分析师关注度则呈现相反趋势。持股比例的负向关联在市场化和公众关注度较高的地区更为显著，但在国有企业中较弱。上述发现表明，外资大股东持股是一种独特的治理安排，其与公司避税行为的关系取决于国内制度及公共信息是否支持外部股东监督。关键词：外资大股东；公司避税；公司治理；跨境持股；外部监督 JEL分类：F21 G34 H26

abstract: This study investigates the health consequences of coal smoke during Japan's early industrialization. Using fixed‐effects models and a prefecture‐level panel dataset on actual coal consumption and infant mortality from 1899 to 1910, this study finds that higher coal consumption was positively associated with infant mortality. The baseline estimate suggests that a one‐standard‐deviation increase in the log of coal consumption was associated with approximately 2.1 additional infant deaths per 1000 live births, and that the growth in coal use was associated with an increase in infant mortality equivalent to approximately 11.8 per cent of the overall rise in infant mortality during the sample period. Further estimates using infant deaths by age interval show that this association was weak during the neonatal period but became more pronounced during the post‐neonatal period, particularly from 1 month to under 6 months after birth. These findings suggest that coal‐based industrialization carried health costs in a non‐Western industrializing economy and that the timing of pollution‐related infant mortality differed from that observed in modern contexts.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了日本早期工业化时期煤炭烟雾对健康的影响。利用固定效应模型及1899年至1910年间县级实际煤炭消费量与婴儿死亡率的面板数据，研究发现煤炭消费量的增加与婴儿死亡率呈正相关。基准估计表明，煤炭消费量对数值每增加一个标准差，与每千名活产婴儿中约增加2.1例死亡相关，且煤炭使用的增长与样本期间婴儿死亡率总体上升中约11.8%的增幅相关联。进一步按婴儿死亡年龄区间进行的估计显示，这一关联在新生儿期较弱，而在新生儿后期，尤其是出生后1个月至6个月期间，表现得更为显著。这些发现表明，在非西方工业化经济体中，以煤炭为基础的工业化带来了健康成本，且污染相关婴儿死亡的时间分布与现代情境下观察到的有所不同。
title: Impacts of coal smoke on infant mortality: Evidence from industrializing Japan
title_zh: 煤烟对婴儿死亡率的影响：来自日本工业化时期的证据

abstract: This paper refers to interview data collected in six municipalities in the Lecce province of southern Italy, across three waves: 2020, 2021, and 2022. The principal aim of the research was to determine whether compliance with four government-recommended non-pharmaceutical measures to prevent the spread of COVID-19 — indoor and outdoor mask use, and indoor and outdoor physical distancing — differed over the years and, if so, whether these differences were influenced by personal characteristics. Specifically, we focused on the psychological features of self-control, risk aversion, and fear of contracting COVID-19 and their relationships with these four measures. The results suggest that virus mortality, the regulations in force, and experience of the pandemic affected compliance with certain preventive measures across all waves. With regard to psychological features, the three factors of interest were found to predict preferences for, and substitutions across, the measures, with effects that varied across the waves.
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Lessons learned from the COVID-19 pandemic: The role of self-control, risk aversion, and fear of infection in shaping compliance with preventive measures
title_zh: 新冠疫情的经验教训：自我控制、风险规避与感染恐惧在遵守预防措施中的作用

abstract: I study the effect of job loss due to mass layoffs on labor supply, wealth, and spousal labor supply among older workers using high-quality Danish administrative data. Job loss reduces labor earnings, disposable income, and employment across all ages, but short-run losses are largest for older workers. Displaced workers aged 60 to 64 earn 32% less one year after displacement compared to similar non-displaced workers and are more likely to retire and less likely to be homeowners. Job loss also affects partners. While younger partners increase labor supply, older partners are more likely to retire.
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: The effect of job loss on labor supply, wealth, and spousal labor supply for older workers
title_zh: 失业对老年工人劳动供给、财富及配偶劳动供给的影响

abstract: For centuries, economic research has been throttled by scarcity of time, labour, and access to data and methods. This column argues that while AI helps dissolve that constraint, it can also exacerbate challenges the profession is already grappling with. And by blurring the traditional distinction between observing the world and modelling it, AI may even challenge our definition of good research.
title: Plus ça change. AI and the future of economic research: From Galileo back to Socrates
title_zh: 变化越多，不变越多。人工智能与经济研究的未来：从伽利略回到苏格拉底

abstract: Childcare burdens limit productivity among women in the informal sector, but little is known about the optimal design of childcare support. The study randomizes 883 women market vendors in Kampala, Uganda to receive free workplace- or community-based childcare. Free childcare redistributes caregiving away from household members, raises women’s hourly earnings, and improves child development and women’s well-being. Community centers achieve higher utilization and larger gains in development and well-being, while workplace centers generate larger economic impacts. Both models have a high marginal value of public funds. Community centers currently dominate, but workplace-based centers could prove superior if operated at scale.
abstract_zh: 育儿负担限制了非正规部门女性的生产力，但关于育儿支持最优设计的研究尚属匮乏。本研究随机选取乌干达坎帕拉883名女性市场商贩，分别提供免费的工作场所或社区育儿服务。免费育儿将照护责任从家庭成员中转移出来，提高了女性的时薪收入，并促进了儿童发展和女性福祉。社区中心实现了更高的使用率，并在儿童发展和福祉方面带来更大改善，而工作场所中心则产生了更大的经济影响。两种模式均具有较高的公共资金边际价值。目前社区中心占据优势，但若大规模运营，工作场所中心可能展现出更优效果。

title: Childcare for Informal-Sector Workers: Delivery Models, Access, and Welfare
title_zh: 非正规部门从业者的儿童照护：供给模式、可及性与福利

abstract: While the literature on the minimum wage is largely retrospective, analyzing impacts of past policy changes, this paper is uniquely forward-looking, forecasting how a proposed reform in Ukraine would affect future employment, earnings, and social contributions. The analysis simulates these effects by mimicking a proposal that would set a minimum wage floor equal to 40 percent of the previous year’s average wage once martial law is over and increasing the minimum wage by two percentage points annually until reaching 50 percent of the previous year’s average wage. The analysis draws on a 10 percent random sample of 2023 worker-level data from the Pension Fund of Ukraine, covering all jobs with pension contributions in the private sector and nonmilitary public sector. The results indicate that, under the proposal, by the end of the five-year transition period, the minimum wage would be 45 percent above the level it would have reached if adjusted only for wage inflation, which serves as the counterfactual. Projected job losses would be modest (0.51–1.03 percent), while total earnings would increase by up to 3.24 percent. The effect on social contributions and taxes would be the same as the effect on earnings since they are a fixed percentage of earnings in Ukraine. Applied to an administrative data set covering all formal sector workers, the methodology developed in the paper offers a useful tool for policy makers to anticipate the likely effects of the minimum wage reforms that are being considered. The paper concludes by discussing policy implications.
abstract_zh: 尽管关于最低工资的文献大多具有回顾性，分析过去政策变化的影响，本文则具有独特的前瞻性，预测乌克兰拟议中的改革将如何影响未来的就业、收入及社会保障缴款。分析通过模拟一项提案来预测这些效应，该提案设想在戒严令结束后，将最低工资标准设定为前一年平均工资的40%，并每年将最低工资提高两个百分点，直至达到前一年平均工资的50%。分析基于乌克兰养老基金2023年工人层面数据的10%随机样本，覆盖了私营部门及非军事公共部门中所有缴纳养老金的职位。结果表明，在该提案下，至五年过渡期结束时，最低工资将比仅按工资通胀调整（作为反事实情景）所达到的水平高出45%。预计失业影响较小（0.51%至1.03%），而总收入将增长最多3.24%。由于在乌克兰，社会保障缴款和税收占收入的固定比例，其对社会保障缴款和税收的影响将与对收入的影响相同。将该方法应用于覆盖所有正规部门工人的行政数据集，本文开发的方法为政策制定者提供了一个有用的工具，以预判正在考虑中的最低工资改革可能带来的影响。文章最后讨论了政策含义。

title: Minimum Wage Reform in a Wartime Economy: Simulating Impacts from Ukraine’s Proposed Reform
title_zh: 战时经济中的最低工资改革：乌克兰拟议改革影响的模拟分析

abstract: Will artificial intelligence (AI) help poorer countries catch up? This paper argues that the answer depends less on access to AI than on the capacity to use new knowledge productively. We show that countries have narrowed gaps in capital and schooling more readily than gaps in productivity. Technology can diffuse widely without producing productivity convergence. Measured human capital explains only a modest share of productivity differences in levels, but is associated with sharply different mobility regimes. The estimated transition processes imply an expected time to exit the lowest-productivity state of about 65 years for economies below the estimated human-capital threshold, compared with about 25 years for those above it. This reconciles development accounting with the view of human capital as absorptive capacity. If AI mainly augments skilled workers and capable firms, it may reinforce existing gaps. If it lowers the costs of learning, adaptation, and implementation in weaker-capability economies, it could instead promote convergence. The Intelligence Divide is therefore not simply about access to AI, but about the capacity to turn knowledge into productivity.
abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）会帮助较贫困国家实现赶超吗？本文认为，答案更多地取决于有效运用新知识的能力，而非获取AI的机会。我们指出，各国在资本和受教育程度方面的差距缩小得比生产率差距更为迅速。技术可以广泛传播，却未必带来生产率的趋同。可衡量的人力资本仅能解释生产率水平差异中的一小部分，但与截然不同的流动性模式相关联。估算的转型过程表明，对于低于估算人力资本门槛的经济体，脱离最低生产率状态的预期时间约为65年，而高于该门槛的经济体则约为25年。这一发现将发展核算与人力资本作为吸收能力的观点相调和。如果AI主要增强技能型劳动者和有能力的企业，它可能加剧现有差距。如果AI降低了能力较弱经济体中学习、适应和实施的成本，它则可能促进趋同。因此，“智能鸿沟”不仅关乎获取AI的机会，更关乎将知识转化为生产率的能力。
authors: Patrick A. Imam & Jonathan R. W. Temple
title: Relative Development and the Intelligence Divide: Human Capital, Technology Diffusion, and AI
title_zh: 相对发展与智能鸿沟：人力资本、技术扩散与人工智能

abstract: This paper studies the macroeconomic dynamics of conflicts and post-conflict recovery using a newly assembled global dataset covering 194 countries, including 170 conflict onsets and 158 conflict terminations, over the period 1946–2024. Using a local-projection difference-in-differences framework complemented by geocoded firm-level evidence, we trace the evolution of macroeconomic aggregates around conflict onset and termination. We make four contributions. First, output losses from conflicts typically exceed those associated with banking, currency, and sovereign debt crises, as well as severe natural disasters. Second, external-sector dynamics constitute a central mechanism through which wars amplify macroeconomic challenges, despite policymakers’ efforts to contain the war shock. Third, post-conflict recoveries are slow and uneven and depend critically on the durability of peace: conflict resumption stalls recovery prospects, while sustained peace produces only gradual recoveries relative to wartime losses. These recoveries are typically labor-led, while capital accumulation and productivity remain subdued. Fourth, firm-level evidence confirms this labor-led recovery and points to persistent financial constraints that hinder capital rebuilding during the postconflict period.
abstract_zh: 本文利用新构建的覆盖194个国家、包含170次冲突爆发与158次冲突终止的全球数据集（时间跨度为1946-2024年），研究冲突及冲突后恢复的宏观经济动态。通过采用局部投影双重差分框架，并辅以地理编码的企业层面证据，我们追踪了冲突爆发与终止前后宏观经济总量的演变过程。本文做出四项贡献。第一，冲突造成的产出损失通常超过银行业危机、货币危机、主权债务危机以及严重自然灾害所带来的损失。第二，外部部门动态是战争加剧宏观经济挑战的核心机制，尽管政策制定者努力遏制战争冲击。第三，冲突后的经济复苏缓慢且不均衡，其关键取决于和平的持久性：冲突再起会阻碍复苏前景，而持续和平仅能带来相对于战时损失的渐进式恢复。此类复苏通常以劳动力为主导，而资本积累与生产率则持续低迷。第四，企业层面的证据证实了这种劳动力主导的复苏模式，并指出在冲突后时期，持续的金融约束阻碍了资本重建。
authors: Hippolyte W. Balima & Colombe Ladreit & Andresa Helena Lagerborg & Mr. Flavien Moreau & Mr. Andrea F Presbitero & Evgenia Weaver
title: Macroeconomics of War and Recovery
title_zh: 战争与复苏的宏观经济学

abstract: We propose a tractable small-open-economy model in which uncovered interest parity premia on foreign exchange (FX) markets arise from the endogenous lack of insurability of exchange rate risks. Asymmetric information about monetary policy can make the tails of the exchange rate distribution uninsurable in FX hedging markets, which in turn generates premia in FX spot markets because of the risk aversion of lenders holding the external debt. There is a role for government intervention because of an information sensitivity externality: agents do not internalize that their actions can reduce the insurability of exchange rates. The model predicts that premia may be amplified by weaknesses in monetary, fiscal, and financial policy frameworks, and can be reduced through reforms which reduce the sensitivity of exchange rates to private information. The constrained efficient policy depends on the composition of external lenders and may include delegation of monetary policy to an “aloof central banker”, constraints on fiscal policy, more active use of macroprudential tools, and institutions which limit asymmetric information.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个易于处理的小型开放经济模型，在该模型中，外汇市场上未覆盖利率平价溢价源于汇率风险内生性的不可保险性。货币政策信息不对称可能导致汇率分布的尾部在外汇对冲市场中无法保险，进而因持有外部债务的贷款人风险厌恶而在外汇即期市场产生溢价。政府干预存在必要性，源于信息敏感性外部性：个体未内化其行为可能降低汇率的可保险性。模型预测，溢价可能因货币、财政及金融政策框架的薄弱而被放大，而通过改革减少汇率对私人信息的敏感性则可降低溢价。约束有效政策取决于外部贷款人的构成，可能包括将货币政策委托给“超然央行行长”、对财政政策施加约束、更积极地运用宏观审慎工具，以及设立限制信息不对称的制度。
authors: Mr. Suman S Basu & Pablo Winant
title: A Model of Macroeconomic Policies with Endogenously Insurable Exchange Rates
title_zh: 内生可保汇率下的宏观经济政策模型

abstract: Models of external balances rely on economic fundamentals, structural indicators, cyclical variables, and policy factors. However, existing models may not fully capture the effects of restrictions on trade payments and capital controls. In this paper, we include two new policy variables in a standard empirical model of the current account to address this gap: the Measure of Aggregate Trade Restrictions (MATR) and the FinOpen index. The results indicate that tighter restrictions on trade payments of one standard deviation are associated with increases in the current account balance of about one percentage point and an appreciation of the real effective exchange rate (REER). These effects primarily operate through suppressing import demand and reducing domestic absorption. Tightening capital inflow restrictions by one standard deviation increases the current account balance by about 1.4 percentage points and depreciates the REER. Outflow restrictions operate in the opposite direction. These effects are primarily due to a wedge between domestic and global real interest rates, which in turn affect saving and investment decisions. Updating these models to assess how trade payment and capital controls affect current account balances helps support more actionable policy recommendations.
abstract_zh: 外部平衡模型依赖于经济基本面、结构性指标、周期性变量及政策因素。然而，现有模型可能未能充分捕捉贸易支付限制与资本管制的影响。为弥补这一缺口，本文在标准经常账户实证模型中引入了两个新的政策变量：总体贸易限制度量（MATR）与金融开放指数（FinOpen）。研究结果显示，贸易支付限制收紧一个标准差，与经常账户余额增加约一个百分点及实际有效汇率（REER）升值相关联。这些效应主要通过抑制进口需求和减少国内吸收发挥作用。资本流入限制收紧一个标准差，会使经常账户余额增加约1.4个百分点，并导致实际有效汇率贬值。而资本流出限制则产生相反效应。这些影响主要源于国内与国际实际利率之间的差异，进而影响储蓄与投资决策。更新这些模型以评估贸易支付与资本管制如何影响经常账户余额，有助于提出更具操作性的政策建议。
authors: Adam Jakubik & Effie Karfaki & Tobias Krahnke & Wenjie Li & Ms. Anita Tuladhar & Chenyu Xu
title: The Impact of Trade Payment Restrictions and Capital Controls on External Sector Balances
title_zh: 贸易支付限制与资本管制对外部部门收支平衡的影响

abstract: We study the determinants of US dollar demand across market participants and traded instruments using survey-based exchange rate and macroeconomic expectations. To empirically establish the relevance of survey-based expectations for currency flows, we leverage granular foreign exchange trading data and present three main findings. First, end-user investors increase their dollar purchases when they expect the US dollar to appreciate. Investment funds and non-dealer banks adjust their synthetic dollar borrowing in the FX swap market in response to forecasted changes in synthetic dollar funding costs. Second, cross-sectionally, investors rebalance along the factor structure of currency risk into dollars following an expected dollar appreciation. Third, the predictive power of survey forecasts weakens when forecaster disagreement or uncertainty rises. Overall, our findings show that long-horizon expectations predict dollar demand across spot, forward, and swap currency markets.
abstract_zh: 我们利用基于调查的汇率和宏观经济预期，研究了不同市场参与者和交易工具间美元需求的决定因素。为实证确立基于调查的预期对货币流动的相关性，我们利用了细粒度外汇交易数据，并提出三项主要发现。首先，终端用户投资者在预期美元升值时增加其美元购买。投资基金和非经销商银行则根据对合成美元融资成本的预测变化，调整其在外汇掉期市场中的合成美元借贷。其次，从横截面角度看，在预期美元升值后，投资者会沿着货币风险因子结构进行再平衡，转向美元。第三，当预测者分歧或不确定性上升时，调查预测的预测能力减弱。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，长期预期能预测即期、远期及掉期货币市场中的美元需求。
authors: Benedikt Ballensiefen & Fabricius Somogyi & Hannah L Winterberg
title: Demand for Dollars: Evidence from Survey Expectations
title_zh: 美元需求：来自调查预期的证据

abstract: Electricity blackouts impose substantial costs in developing countries. We advance a new explanation for their prevalence in India: utilities’ wholesale electricity demand is downward-sloping. We construct a novel dataset on India’s wholesale electricity sector. Instrumenting for average variable cost with plausibly exogenous power plant equipment outages, we estimate a wholesale demand elasticity of −0.49. Voltage monitoring data confirm that equipment outages drive blackouts. Increases in procurement costs therefore reduce the quantity of electricity delivered to end-use consumers. Our counterfactual simulations suggest that lowering wholesale electricity costs could eliminate blackouts for millions of Indian households.
abstract_zh: 电力停电在发展中国家造成了巨大成本。我们为印度停电普遍存在提出了一种新的解释：公用事业部门的批发电需求呈向下倾斜趋势。我们构建了一个关于印度批发电部门的新数据集。利用看似外生的电厂设备故障作为平均可变成本的工具变量，我们估计出批发电需求弹性为-0.49。电压监测数据证实，设备故障导致了停电。因此，采购成本的增加会减少向终端用户输送的电量。我们的反事实模拟表明，降低批发电成本可能为印度数百万家庭消除停电现象。
title: Blackouts: The Role of India’s Wholesale Electricity Market
title_zh: 停电：印度电力批发市场的作用

abstract: Universal health coverage is a central goal in many low-income countries. We conducted a large, four-year randomized trial of premiums and subsidies for India’s first national public hospital insurance program, RSBY. Demand was substantial (~60% uptake) even at prices equal to the government’s premium cost, but enrollment showed strong adverse selection. Insurance increased claims but not healthcare use, implying primarily financial benefits. Many enrollees failed when attempting to use coverage, underscoring the importance of learning. We find little effect on health outcomes. Given India’s high marginal cost of public funds, universal free insurance is unlikely to raise welfare.
title: Evaluating and Pricing Health Insurance in Lower-Income Countries: A Field Experiment in India
title_zh: 评估低收入国家健康保险的定价与需求：来自印度的实地实验

abstract: This paper assesses the literature that links macroeconomics and climate change. We organize the paper around three themes: (i) loss and damage, which analyzes long-run economic costs and non-market impacts from climate change; (ii) mitigation and the energy transition, which evaluates the macroeconomic consequences of shifting away from fossil fuels toward renewable energy; and (iii) adaptation, which explores the economic adjustments to manage heat exposure, increasingly frequent severe weather events, and rising seas. We discuss macroeconomic frameworks that incorporate these forces as well as empirical estimates that guide their calibration. We suggest areas in which macroeconomic research on climate is needed.
title: A Guide to Macroeconomics and Climate Change
title_zh: 宏观经济学与气候变化指南

abstract: How do inflation expectations affect the job search behavior of workers when wages are set in nominal terms? A canonical job search model incorporating nominal wage rigidities predicts that on-the-job search should increase with expected inflation. Using novel survey questions, we show that workers are more likely to search at higher values of hypothetical inflation. In the Survey of Consumer Expectations, within-respondent variation in inflation expectations predicts on-the-job search.
title: Job Search, Wages, and Inflation
title_zh: 求职、工资与通货膨胀

abstract: Using German administrative data, we document that high-wage locations have lower labor shares and higher wage dispersion. We show that a parsimonious model, in which firm monopsony power stems from search frictions, can explain these facts if "superstar" firms sort into productive locations. This positive sorting, which emerges under sufficiently strong firm–location complementarity or large frictions, steepens local wage ladders and raises wages and wage inequality. Moreover, sorting reduces labor shares because more productive firms have more monopsony power. Our estimates indicate that firm sorting rationalizes lower local labor shares in high-wage locations and 40% of their increased wage dispersion.
title: Spatial Firm Sorting and Local Monopsony Power
title_zh: 空间企业分类与地方买方垄断势力
